strings.HomeSubtitle: Create a watch face for Amazfit Active 2 (Round) or continue where you left off.
strings.NewProjectDesc: Start from a blank 466 × 466 watch face.
strings.OpenProjectDesc: Open a project folder created with Rusty Watch.
strings.NoRecentDesc: Create a new project or open an existing one to see it here.
strings.TimeDisplayDesc: Only the time widget is available for now.
strings.FormatHint: Tokens: HH, H, hh, h, MM, M, SS, S, A, a. Use \ before a literal character.
strings.DateFormatHint: D/d day, DD/dd padded, M/m month, MM/mm padded. Names: MMM/mmm = Jan/jan, MMMM/mmmm = January/january, DDD/ddd = Mon/mon, DDDD/dddd = Monday/monday. Five or six letters = UPPERCASE. YY/YYYY year. Use \ before a literal.
strings.WidgetFontHint: The preview renders with the same TTF file that is exported to the watchface.
strings.FrameHint: Drag the frame to move the widget. Drag its corners to resize it. Double-click the frame to make the text scale with it (red frame).
strings.ScaleModeOnLabel: Scaling with frame: ON (double-click to turn off)
strings.ScaleModeOffLabel: Scaling with frame: OFF (double-click to turn on)
strings.ScaleModeOn: Text now scales with the frame.
strings.ScaleModeOff: Frame resizing no longer scales the text.
strings.ScaleModeOnHands: Hands now scale with the frame.
strings.ScaleModeOffHands: Frame resizing no longer scales the hands.
strings.PositionHint: Tap to copy · double-tap to edit
strings.LayersDesc: Layers are drawn from bottom to top. Use the arrows to change order and the eye to hide a layer. Double-click empty space to clear the selection — the preview matches the exported watchface.
strings.WidgetSettingsDesc: Changes apply to the selected widget and are saved automatically.
strings.WidgetsDesc: Widgets supported by Rusty Watch. To add one to a watchface, use the Add widget button above the editor preview.
strings.TimeWidgetCardDesc: A text widget showing the current time with a configurable format.
strings.AnalogWidgetCardDesc: A clock with rotating hour, minute and optional second hands plus a center cap.
strings.DateWidgetCardDesc: A text widget showing the current date with an abbreviated month name.
strings.WeekdayNumberWidgetCardDesc: Weekday number 1-7 from the watch TIME sensor. The editor preview shows -- because the PC has no sensor.
strings.WeekNumberWidgetCardDesc: ISO week number (1-53) computed with the same algorithm in the editor preview and in the exported watchface.
strings.DayOfYearWidgetCardDesc: Day of year (1-366) computed with the same algorithm in the editor preview and in the exported watchface.
strings.LunarDateWidgetCardDesc: Chinese lunar month and day from the TIME sensor. The editor preview shows --/-- because the PC has no sensor.
strings.FestivalWidgetCardDesc: Holiday name from the TIME sensor. Lunar festivals and solar terms are only available when the watch language is Chinese.
strings.WorldClockWidgetCardDesc: City and time from the watch's configured world clock. Shows -- if no world clock is configured.
strings.ImagesWidgetCardDesc: A static image from Assets → Images. Choose an image and a fit mode; the PNG is resized to the frame before export.
strings.TextWidgetCardDesc: A text field where you type your own content. It is exported to the watchface as-is.
strings.UserTextHint: Type the text to show on the watchface. It is saved in the project and exported without changes.
strings.StepWidgetCardDesc: A text widget showing the step count read from the watch sensor.
strings.StepCounterHint: The value is read from the step sensor on the watch. The editor preview shows 0 because there is no sensor on the PC.
strings.SensorInfoBattery: The battery level is read from the watch sensor. The editor preview shows 100% because there is no battery sensor on the PC.
strings.SensorInfoWeather: The value is read from the watch's weather data. The editor preview uses predefined sample data because the PC has no weather sensor.
strings.DistanceWidgetCardDesc: A text widget showing today's distance from the watch sensor, in kilometres or miles.
strings.MeasurementSystemDesc: Used by new distance widgets and by the exported watchface. 'Follow watch' (default) reads the unit from the watch setting at runtime. A widget can override it in its own settings.
strings.FirstDayOfWeekDesc: Used by the weekday-number field in the preview and in the exported watchface. Monday (default) gives 1-7 from Monday to Sunday; Sunday gives 1-7 from Sunday to Saturday.
strings.OwnDistanceUnit: Use own unit system for this widget
strings.DistanceUnitDesc: When enabled, this widget uses its own unit instead of the default. 'Follow watch' reads the watch's unit setting; the watch reads distance in metres and converts it on the device.
strings.StepTargetWidgetCardDesc: A text widget showing the daily step goal read from the watch's STEP sensor.
strings.CaloriesTargetWidgetCardDesc: A text widget showing the daily calorie goal read from the watch's CALORIE sensor. The unit can be hidden in the widget settings.
strings.StandTargetWidgetCardDesc: A text widget showing the standing-hours goal. Warning: the STAND sensor may not be available on Amazfit Active 2 — the field will then keep its default value.
strings.FatBurningTargetWidgetCardDesc: A text widget showing the fat-burning minutes goal. Warning: the FAT_BURRING sensor may not be available on Amazfit Active 2 — the field will then keep its default value.
strings.GoalSensorHint: The value is read from the sensor on the watch. The editor preview shows a fixed goal because the PC has no sensors.
strings.GoalSensorWarning: Warning: Amazfit Active 2 may not expose this sensor. If it is missing, the watchface keeps the default value from the project.
strings.HeartWidgetCardDesc: Text widget showing the last recorded heart rate from the watch sensor (HEART.last), in bpm.
strings.StressWidgetCardDesc: Text widget showing the current stress level from the watch sensor, on a 0-100 scale.
strings.PaiWidgetCardDesc: Text widget showing today's PAI score from the watch sensor.
strings.SkinTempWidgetCardDesc: Text widget showing the skin temperature measured by the watch, in °C.
strings.SleepWidgetCardDesc: Text widget showing last night's total sleep time from the watch sensor.
strings.CaloriesWidgetCardDesc: Text widget showing calories burned today from the watch sensor, in kcal.
strings.Spo2WidgetCardDesc: Text widget showing the latest SpO₂ reading from the watch sensor, in percent.
strings.StandWidgetCardDesc: Text widget showing today's standing hours from the watch's STAND sensor. Warning: STAND may not be available on Amazfit Active 2.
strings.FatBurningWidgetCardDesc: Text widget showing today's fat-burning minutes from the watch's FAT_BURRING sensor. Warning: FAT_BURRING may not be available on Amazfit Active 2.
strings.PaiWeeklyWidgetCardDesc: Text widget showing cumulative PAI (totalpai) from the watch's PAI sensor.
strings.WidgetsSoon: More widget types will appear here later.
strings.ErrorWidgetCatalog: Could not load the widget catalog
strings.Author: Author
strings.ValidationAppId: App ID must be a whole number greater than 0.
strings.LanguageDesc: Choose the interface language. English is the default on first launch; the change applies immediately. Catalogs are loaded from %APPDATA%\RustyWatch\Localization — add a <code>.json file there and click Reload to use a new language without reinstalling.
strings.WatchfaceLanguageDesc: English is the default. This choice selects which variant is shown in the editor preview AND saved into the generated preview.png/preview.gif. The watchface itself always detects the watch language (Polish only for pl-PL, English for every other language).
strings.DefaultAuthorDesc: Used when creating a new watchface. Clear the field to go back to your Windows user name.
strings.ProjectsFolderDesc: New projects are created here. Settings and the recent list live in %APPDATA%\RustyWatch, so they survive app updates.
strings.AssetsDesc: Fonts are stored in one place (%APPDATA%/RustyWatch/Fonts) and can be used by every project. Each project keeps its own copy, so a watchface can be shared as a self-contained folder.
strings.AssetsFontsDesc: New projects and widgets use the watch system font by default. Add a .ttf file to use it in any project; the bundled Inter font is optional and licensed under SIL OFL 1.1 — you can include it in your repository.
strings.AssetsFontRemoved: Font removed from the store. Copies inside projects are untouched.
strings.AssetsImagesDesc: Import PNG or JPEG graphics for the IMAGES widget. Select an image in the widget settings; it is resized to the frame with the chosen fit mode before export.
strings.AssetsImageRemoved: Image removed from the store. Copies inside projects are untouched.
strings.AssetsHandsDesc: Hand sets for the analog clock. A folder must contain hour.png and minute.png; second.png and cap.png are optional. All images must be square PNGs of the same size. The hands keep their subtle shadow.
strings.AssetsHandsAddFailed: Could not add the hand set.
strings.AssetsHandsRemoved: Hand set removed from the store. Copies inside projects are untouched.
strings.ImageFitDesc: Cover crops to fill the frame, contain keeps the whole image with transparent padding, stretch ignores the aspect ratio. The PNG in the project is physically resized before export.
strings.AnalogHandSetDesc: Hand images are copied into the project and centred on the watchface. Add your own sets in Assets → Hands.
strings.HandsApplyFailed: Could not change the hand set.
strings.NameReadOnlyDesc: The name is fixed for this project. Use "Save as..." to create a copy with a different name.
strings.ProjectSettingsDesc: Change the author or version of this watchface. The name stays the same. Changes are saved when you click the button.
strings.ErrorProjectSettings: Could not save the project settings
strings.ErrorVersion: Could not read the app version
strings.ErrorRecentList: Could not load the recent projects list
strings.ErrorTimeSettings: Could not load the time settings
strings.ErrorSaveAs: Could not save a copy of the project
strings.ErrorOpenDialog: Could not open the project dialog: {0}
strings.SelectRecent: Select a project from the list
strings.ClearedRecent: The recent projects list has been cleared
strings.ExportFirst: Create or open a project first
strings.ErrorExportPreview: Could not generate the animated preview
strings.ErrorExportPreviewDetail: Could not generate the animated preview: {0}
strings.EmulatorPreparing: Preparing the watchface for the simulator...
strings.EmulatorStarted: Watchface installed in the simulator. Check the watch window; log: {0}
strings.EmulatorMissingZeus: Zeus CLI not found. Install it with: npm i -g @zeppos/zeus-cli
strings.ErrorEmulator: Could not start the emulator test: {0}
strings.EmulatorHint: Open the Zepp OS Simulator and the Active 2 (Round) device simulator first.
strings.EmulatorNotInstalled: Zepp OS Simulator was not found. Opening its official download page — install it (its own license applies), then try again.
strings.EmulatorDeviceMissing: The Active 2 (Round) device image is missing. In the simulator click the download icon and install Active 2 v1.1.0 (OS 5.0, API 4.2), then try again.
strings.EmulatorDeviceClosed: The watch window is not open. In Zepp OS Simulator click Emulator (Active 2 v1.1.0), then try again.
strings.QrHint: Scan in Zepp App → Developer Mode → Scan. Phone and PC must be on the same network; keep this window open and allow the port through Windows Firewall. URL: {0}
strings.SyncHint: Upload the ZIP through Zepp developer mode or by scanning a QR code
strings.ErrAppId: App ID must be greater than 0
strings.ErrLayerBounds: The layer cannot be moved any further
strings.ErrLastWidget: The project must contain at least one widget
strings.ErrVersionLength: Watchface version can have at most
strings.ErrVersionChars: Watchface version cannot contain whitespace or control characters
strings.ErrTimeLength: Time format can have at most
strings.ErrTimeControl: Time format cannot contain control characters
strings.ErrTimeEscape: Time format ends with an incomplete escape sequence
strings.ErrTimeToken: Time format must contain at least one token
strings.ErrDateLength: Date format can have at most
strings.ErrDateControl: Date format cannot contain control characters
strings.ErrDateEscape: Date format ends with an unfinished escape character
strings.ErrDateToken: Date format must contain at least one token (D, M or Y)
strings.ErrBounds: Time widget must fit within the
strings.ErrNoTimeWidget: Project does not contain a time widget
strings.ErrFontDefaultReplace: The default font cannot be replaced
strings.ErrFontDefaultRemove: The default font cannot be removed
strings.ErrImageExt: Image must be a PNG or JPEG file
strings.ErrHandsSize: Hour and minute hands must have the same size
strings.ErrHandsSquare: Hand images must be square PNG files
strings.ErrHandsExists: hand set is already in the store
strings.ErrHandsDefaultRemove: The bundled hand set cannot be removed
strings.CustomDataDesc: Override the values shown in the editor preview. These settings are never written to the watchface.
strings.CustomDataEmpty: Add a time, date or sensor widget to override its values here.
strings.CustomDataHint: Values are stored in app settings. They are always used for weather and sensors; Live preview only replaces time and date with the real system clock.
strings.ErrorCustomData: Could not open the custom data settings.
strings.BatteryWidgetCardDesc: Battery level from the watch sensor (BATTERY).
strings.StatusAlarmWidgetCardDesc: Shown by the watch when an alarm is set.
strings.StatusDndWidgetCardDesc: Shown by the watch when Do Not Disturb is on.
strings.StatusBluetoothWidgetCardDesc: Shown by the watch when Bluetooth is disconnected.
strings.StatusLockWidgetCardDesc: Shown by the watch when the screen is locked.
strings.StatusIconPackDesc: Packs are read from %APPDATA%\RustyWatch\Status. Each pack needs alarm.png, dnd.png, bluetooth.png and lock.png.
strings.AssetsStatusDesc: Ready-made icon packs for the four system status widgets. Each pack needs four square PNG files.
strings.AssetsStatusAddFailed: Could not add the status icon pack.
strings.StatusApplyFailed: Could not assign the status icon pack.
strings.SleepTargetWidgetCardDesc: Text widget showing the user's sleep target from hmSetting.getSleepTarget(). Shows -- h when no target is configured.
strings.WeatherConditionWidgetCardDesc: Today (day 0): current condition from the watch firmware, including night variants. Days 1-4: daily forecast from the WEATHER sensor. Watch language (PL/EN).
strings.WeatherCityWidgetCardDesc: City name from the watch's WEATHER sensor. Polish watch language shows Warszawa, English shows Warsaw.
strings.WeatherHighWidgetCardDesc: Today's forecast high temperature from the watch's WEATHER sensor.
strings.WeatherLowWidgetCardDesc: Today's forecast low temperature from the watch's WEATHER sensor.
strings.SunriseWidgetCardDesc: Today's sunrise time (HH:MM) from the watch's WEATHER sensor.
strings.SunsetWidgetCardDesc: Today's sunset time (HH:MM) from the watch's WEATHER sensor.
strings.WeatherIconWidgetCardDesc: One of 29 weather icons selected at runtime from the watch's WEATHER condition code. Blue frame moves; double-click for red stretch mode.
strings.WeatherIconPackDesc: system-like = ZeppOS system-style icons. All 29 icons scale together.
strings.AssetsWeatherDesc: system-like: the default ZeppOS-style icons. Each pack contains all 29 condition icons.
strings.HeartMinWidgetCardDesc: Text widget showing the lowest heart rate recorded today (from HEART.today).
strings.HeartMaxWidgetCardDesc: Text widget showing the highest heart rate recorded today (from HEART.today).
strings.HeartAvgWidgetCardDesc: Text widget showing the average heart rate recorded today (from HEART.today).
strings.SleepScoreWidgetCardDesc: Text widget showing last night sleep score from the watch sensor.
strings.SleepDeepWidgetCardDesc: Deep sleep duration in minutes or as a percentage of total sleep.
strings.SleepLightWidgetCardDesc: Light sleep duration in minutes or as a percentage of total sleep.
strings.SleepRemWidgetCardDesc: REM sleep duration in minutes or as a percentage of total sleep.
strings.SleepStartWidgetCardDesc: Time when sleep started, formatted as HH:MM.
strings.SleepEndWidgetCardDesc: Time when sleep ended, formatted as HH:MM.
strings.SensorInfoSleep: Sleep data is read from the watch sensor (updated about every 30 minutes). The editor preview uses predefined sample values.
strings.Spo2HourAvgWidgetCardDesc: Text widget showing the average blood oxygen level for the current hour (SPO2.hourAvgofDay).
strings.PaiPrepaiWidgetCardDesc: Sum of today PAI and the six previous days (dailypai + prepai0..5).
strings.SleepWakeWidgetCardDesc: Time spent awake during the night (WAKE_STAGE), shown in minutes or as a percentage of sleep.
strings.WeatherCurrentWidgetCardDesc: Temperature read by the watch firmware (hmUI.data_type.WEATHER_CURRENT). Only alignment, size, font, colour and opacity are editable; the value itself is not.
strings.SunCurrentWidgetCardDesc: Time remaining until the next sunrise or sunset, calculated from the watch time and tide data.
strings.ArcProgressWidgetCardDesc: Arc showing a sensor value 0-100%, with rounded caps, optional track and segments.
strings.BarProgressWidgetCardDesc: Rounded bar showing a sensor value 0-100%, continuous or segmented.
strings.ShortcutWidgetCardDesc: Invisible tap zone that opens a watch app or data screen. Shown as a hatch in the editor.
